questions.question: Where should the new VAT-rate table live?

options.label: New api/src/vat.ts (Recommended)
options.description: Its own module next to markets.ts, exporting the table and a vatFor(code) lookup that cart.ts calls.

options.label: Inside markets.ts
options.description: A second table in markets.ts beside MARKETS, so all market data stays in one file.

options.label: Inside cart.ts
options.description: Private to cartTotal, since it's the only reader today.

questions.question: What should happen when a market is missing from the VAT table?

options.label: Throw an error (Recommended)
options.description: Fail loudly, the way marketFor does today for an unknown market, so a cart is never priced with the wrong VAT.

options.label: Fall back to 0% VAT
options.description: Price the cart without VAT and carry on. This silently undercharges if a rate is forgotten.

options.label: Fall back to a default rate
options.description: Use one configured default rate (e.g. 25%) for any market without its own entry.
